raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: exactextract
  version: "0.3.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/exactextract-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5864eab819474967e30c6a0118af3658da08d0b5ec1c2b8f747fb009b6b7856c

build:
  number: 5
  skip: match(python, "==3.8")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - cmake
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - make
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - geos
    - libgdal-core
    - scikit-build-core
    - pybind11
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - numpy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - exactextract
      pip_check: false
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
    script:
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then: pip check

about:
  summary: Fast and accurate raster zonal statistics
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/isciences/exactextract

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dbaston
    - akrherz
